en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim Al Batal, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
[17:71] The Day when We will Call every human being with their Imam
’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Their Imam<sup>asws</sup> would be that who will be in appearance before them, and he<sup>asws</sup> is Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> of the people of his<sup>asws</sup> era’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Shammun from ‘Abdallah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from ‘Abdallah ibn al-Qasim al-Batal from ‘Abdallah ibn Sinan who has said the following.
“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the meaning of , ‘On the day when We will call every nation with her Imam (leader) . .”
[17:71] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to the Imam who is with them and he is al-Qa’im of the people of that time.”
